about.title: Our Essence
about.text1: In the center of Viseu, Viriatus Brunch is a welcoming space that combines creative flavors with fresh, quality ingredients. The entire menu was designed to please all tastes, in a relaxed environment where every detail invites you to enjoy.

values.title: Passion for Flavor
values.description: Each dish is a work of art, created with love and dedication.

values.title: Local Freshness
values.description: We prioritize ingredients from our Viseu region to ensure the highest quality.

values.title: Brunch Experience
values.description: We transform a meal into a moment of pure pleasure and relaxation.

footer.tagline: Inspired by Viseu, created for every day. Fresh flavors, simple moments.

contactos.title: We are waiting for you
contactos.subtitle: Visit us in the heart of Viseu or get in touch for any questions.
contactos.reserva_sub: For reservations, special requests, or any questions, please contact us.

galeria_page.subtitle: Every detail, every ingredient, and every smile captured in our space. Explore our essence through the lens.
galeria_page.social_text: Use the hashtag #viriatusbrunch and appear in our official gallery. We want to see your moment!
